description: This file defines the BasicUserRoleManager class, which extends AbstractUserRoleManager and manages user permissions, roles, and access control within the OrangeHRM system. It provides mechanisms to determine accessible entities, roles, modules, screen permissions, and workflows based on user roles, integrating various services and handling role filtering and permission checks.

classes.name: BasicUserRoleManager
classes.description: This class manages user roles and permissions, providing methods for access control, permissions retrieval, role filtering, and workflow management within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It initializes predefined roles and interacts with several services to enforce security and access policies.
